app.name: Task Dashboard
app.description: A full-stack GTD-inspired task management dashboard with project organization, Kanban boards, priority matrix, Pomodoro timer, subtasks, tagging, and activity tracking.

architecture.description: Monorepo with separate client/ and server/ directories. Express API server with SQLite database serves a React SPA. Client proxies API calls to server during development.

middleware.name: cors
middleware.purpose: Cross-origin requests from React dev server

client.stateManagement: React useState/useCallback hooks (no external state library)
client.routing: none (single-page with view switching via state)

tables.name: tasks
tables.description: Individual task items belonging to projects

tables.name: tags
tables.description: Labels and GTD context tags (prefixed with @)

columns.name: name
columns.description: Tag name, context tags start with @ (e.g. '@computer')

columns.name: is_context
columns.description: Boolean (0/1): GTD context tag vs regular tag

tables.name: task_tags
tables.description: Many-to-many junction table between tasks and tags

tables.name: subtasks
tables.description: Nested checklist items within a task

tables.name: task_notes
tables.description: Rich markdown notes / journal entries per task

columns.name: is_builtin
columns.description: Boolean (0/1): built-in templates cannot be deleted

tables.name: activity_log
tables.description: Audit trail of all changes to projects, tasks, and tags

columns.name: changes
columns.description: JSON object: { field: { old: value, new: value } }

endpoints.summary: Get all projects with their tasks, tags, note counts, and subtask stats
Generate a markdown summary of all tasks, priorities, overdue items, subtask progress
Permanently delete a project and all its tasks (CASCADE)
Create a new task in a project
endpoints.businessLogic: Auto-assigns next task_number. Auto-sets progress=100 when status is COMPLETED/DONE.

endpoints.summary: Reorder tasks across all projects (All Tasks view)
Bulk move multiple tasks to a different project

endpoints.businessLogic: Auto-sets progress=100 when status is COMPLETED/DONE. Logs detailed field-level change audit.

endpoints.summary: Delete a task (soft delete by default, permanent if ?permanent=true)
Toggle pin status on a task
Move a single task to a different project
Replace all tags on a task
Get activity log for a specific task
Get all notes for a task
Create a note for a task
Get all subtasks for a task with completion stats
Toggle subtask completion and return updated stats
Get pomodoro stats and session history for a task
Create a tag (auto-detects context if name starts with @)
Update a tag name or color
Get paginated activity log with optional entity filters
Get the currently active pomodoro session (auto-completes expired ones)
Change the task linked to an active pomodoro session
Get a single task template by ID
Create a template from an existing task
Update a user-created template (built-in templates are immutable)
Delete a user-created template (built-in cannot be deleted)
Export all projects and tasks as YAML-formatted text

viewModes.label: Projects View
viewModes.description: Card-based project view with expandable task tables

viewModes.label: All Tasks
viewModes.description: Flat table of all tasks across projects with drag-and-drop

viewModes.label: Priority Matrix
viewModes.description: Eisenhower matrix (DO FIRST / SCHEDULE / DELEGATE / ELIMINATE)

viewModes.label: Kanban Board
viewModes.description: Swim lanes by status (PENDING → INPROGRESS → COMPLETED)

components.name: App
components.description: Fetches data from /api/tasks, manages loading/error states, provides theme and undo toast context to children.

components.name: Dashboard
components.description: Contains header, sidebar, stats bar, search/filter bars, and switches between Projects/Tasks/Priority/Kanban views. Manages all CRUD operations, view preferences (persisted to localStorage), and keyboard shortcuts.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: Collapsible project list grouped by status (Active, Completed, Archived). Shows project avatars with color-coded initials. Scrolls-to and highlights projects.

components.name: ProjectCard
components.description: Expandable card showing project info, task count stats, and embedded TaskTable. Supports edit, archive, and delete actions.

components.name: TaskTable
components.description: Sortable, filterable table of tasks within a project. Supports inline editing, drag-and-drop reorder, status/priority badges, progress bars, tag pills, and context menus.

components.name: AllTasksView
components.description: Flat view of all tasks across all projects with sorting, filtering, bulk operations, and drag-and-drop reordering.

components.name: PriorityMatrix
components.description: 4-quadrant grid (DO FIRST, SCHEDULE, DELEGATE, ELIMINATE) showing tasks by urgency/importance. Drag between quadrants to reassign.

components.name: KanbanBoard
components.description: Swim-lane columns by task status. Drag tasks between columns to change status.

components.name: SliderPanel
components.description: Slide-out panel that displays a generated markdown summary (from /api/summary) with task stats, overdue items, and project breakdown.

components.name: SearchFilterBar
components.description: Text search across task titles/comments with filters for status, priority, due date range, and assigned-to.

components.name: ContextFilterBar
components.description: Horizontal bar of GTD context tags (@computer, @calls, etc.) for quick filtering by work context.

components.name: FormModal
components.description: Exports ProjectFormModal and ConfirmDialog. Used for creating/editing projects and confirming destructive actions.

components.name: QuickAddTaskModal
components.description: Keyboard-shortcut-triggered modal (Alt+N) for rapid task creation with project selection.

components.name: QuickInboxModal
components.description: Rapid-fire task capture modal (Alt+I) that adds tasks to the INBOX project with minimal friction.

components.name: TaskTemplatesModal
components.description: Modal for selecting task templates (Alt+T) to create pre-configured tasks with pre-filled fields and checklists.

components.name: PomodoroTimer
components.description: Compact timer widget with start/pause/stop, task linking, duration presets (25/15/5 min), break management, and today's session stats.

components.name: InlineTagEditor
components.description: Inline popover for adding/removing tags from tasks. Supports creating new tags on-the-fly with color picker.

components.name: NaturalDateInput
components.description: Date input that parses natural language ('tomorrow', 'next friday', 'in 3 days', '+5d') into dates.

components.name: TaskNotesPanel
components.description: Slide-out panel for viewing and managing markdown notes/journal entries for a task.

components.name: SubtasksChecklist
components.description: Inline expandable checklist of subtasks with add, toggle, reorder, and delete functionality.

components.name: ReviewMode
components.description: Guided daily/weekly review wizard (Alt+Shift+R) that walks through overdue tasks, inbox processing, and project health checks.

components.name: KeyboardShortcutsHelp
components.description: Modal (Alt+/) showing all available keyboard shortcuts grouped by category.

components.name: FeatureHelpGuide
components.description: Help guide modal explaining all features with tips and usage instructions.

components.name: UndoToast
components.description: Toast notification with undo action for delete/archive operations. Auto-dismisses after timeout.

hooks.name: useTheme
hooks.description: Dark/light theme toggle. Persists to localStorage, respects system prefers-color-scheme. Sets data-theme attribute on <html>.

hooks.name: useHotkeys
hooks.description: Global keyboard shortcut system with 20+ bindings across Actions, Navigation, View, and Help categories. Ignores inputs, supports Alt/Ctrl/Meta combos.

hooks.name: usePomodoro
hooks.description: Pomodoro timer state management. Syncs with backend sessions, persists to localStorage, supports work/short-break/long-break modes, audio chime via Web Audio API.

hooks.name: useNotifications
hooks.description: Browser push notifications for overdue tasks and tasks due today. Schedules 1-hour-before reminders. Tracks notification history per day in localStorage.

hooks.name: useFaviconBadge
hooks.description: Dynamically renders a red badge with count on the favicon and updates document title with (N) prefix for attention-requiring tasks.

hooks.name: useSnooze
hooks.description: Snooze/dismiss attention banners for configurable durations (15min, 30min, 1hr, 3hrs, end-of-day, tomorrow). Persists to localStorage with auto-expiry.

hooks.name: useNaturalDate
hooks.description: Natural language date parsing. Supports 'today', 'tomorrow', 'next monday', 'in 3 days', '+5d', 'end of week', 'eom', and day-name shortcuts.

styling.approach: Single CSS file with CSS custom properties (variables)

features.name: Project Management
features.description: CRUD operations for projects with status lifecycle (In Progress → Completed → Archived). Cascade delete with tasks.

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Full CRUD with soft-delete/restore, inline editing, drag-and-drop reordering, pinning, cross-project moves, and bulk operations.

features.name: GTD Context Tags
features.description: 10 pre-seeded @-prefixed context tags (@computer, @calls, @email, @errands, @home, @office, @waiting, @read, @focus, @quick) for Getting Things Done methodology. Filter tasks by active context.

features.name: Eisenhower Priority Matrix
features.description: 4-quadrant urgency/importance grid: DO FIRST, SCHEDULE, DELEGATE, ELIMINATE. Drag tasks between quadrants.

features.name: Kanban Board
features.description: Visual workflow columns by task status with drag-and-drop status transitions.

features.name: Pomodoro Timer
features.description: Built-in 25/15/5-minute timer with backend session tracking, task linking, break management, audio chime (Web Audio API), browser notifications on completion, and daily stats.

features.name: Subtasks / Checklists
features.description: Nested checklist items within tasks. Add, toggle, reorder, bulk create. Completion stats shown in task list.

features.name: Task Notes / Journal
features.description: Markdown-formatted notes per task with create, edit, delete. Rendered via react-markdown.

features.name: Task Templates
features.description: 8 built-in templates (Code Review, Bug Investigation, etc.) plus user-created templates. Pre-fill title, priority, quadrant, comments/checklists. Create templates from existing tasks.

features.name: Activity Audit Log
features.description: Full audit trail of all CRUD operations with field-level change tracking (old/new values), entity type filtering, and pagination.

features.name: Smart Summary
features.description: Server-generated markdown summary including health status, overdue tasks, upcoming deadlines, potential blockers (keyword detection), subtask progress, and project breakdown.

features.name: Natural Language Dates
features.description: Parse 'tomorrow', 'next friday', 'in 3 days', '+5d', '+2w', 'end of week', 'eom' into date values.

features.name: Keyboard Shortcuts
features.description: 20+ global keyboard shortcuts for all major actions, navigation, and view switching. Platform-aware display (Mac/PC).

features.name: Browser Notifications
features.description: Push notifications for overdue tasks, tasks due today, and scheduled 1-hour-before reminders. Daily deduplication.

features.name: Favicon Badge
features.description: Dynamic favicon badge with count of attention-requiring tasks (overdue + due today). Updates document title with (N) prefix.

features.name: Snooze Attention Items
features.description: Dismiss overdue/attention banners for configurable durations (15min to end-of-day/tomorrow). Auto-expires.

features.name: Dark / Light Theme
features.description: Full dual-theme support with CSS custom properties. Persists preference, respects system prefers-color-scheme.

features.name: GTD Review Mode
features.description: Guided daily and weekly review workflows that walk through inbox processing, overdue triage, and project health.

features.name: YAML Export
features.description: Export all projects and tasks as YAML-formatted text via /api/yaml.

features.name: Search & Filter
features.description: Full-text search across titles and comments. Filters by status, priority, due date range, and assignee.
